name: Whispers of Love
source:
Whispers of Love is an Otome game, with a cosmic horror theme inspired by Lovecraft's novels.

In this game you will play the role of Narumi Yoshida, a girl suffering from nightmares, and with the help of the Yugen Association, you will manage to solve the meaning of her nightmares and other truths. The most traumatic situations are the ones that unite people the most or make you fall into madness.

[translated/edited from [url=https://kristagames.itch.io/whispers-of-love]itch.io[/url]]
